name: Caracol Televisión
body: Descriptions and share cards on every page analyzed, a NewsMediaOrganization entity, and alt text on every image. But robots.txt disallows ChatGPT-User, the agent that opens a page when a person asks ChatGPT about it.
lesson: Block training crawlers if you choose, but allow user-triggered agents. They bring readers to your pages.
summary: www.caracoltv.com scores 83 out of 100 (B). 2 checks fail now, 15 are at risk, and 23 pass. Fix first: 1 AI answer or search crawler is blocked.

fix.title: 1 AI answer or search crawler is blocked
fix.evidence: ChatGPT-User (ChatGPT, when a person asks it to open a page) by Disallow: /. These bots fetch pages to cite them in answers. Blocked means the site is not quoted there.
fix.fix: Allow the answer bots in robots.txt. Training bots can stay blocked if that is the policy.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: 18 pages do not have exactly one h1
fix.fix: Give each page one h1 that names it.

fix.title: Lighthouse scores performance 38/100 on mobile
fix.evidence: Lighthouse 13.5.0 on a simulated mid-range phone over slow 4G: Largest Contentful Paint 14.9 s, Total Blocking Time 1130 ms, Cumulative Layout Shift 0.012, Speed Index 6.7 s.
fix.fix: Open PageSpeed Insights for this URL and work through its opportunities, largest savings first.

fix.title: 9 titles run past about 60 characters
fix.evidence: /desafio (76), /juegos (79), /yo-me-llamo/en-vivo-yo-me-llamo-capitulo-hoy-20-de-octubre-gratis-pr30 (96), /actualidad/murio-german-quintero-actor-de-pasion-de-gavilanes-a-los-72-anos-ed45 (80) and 5 more. Google cuts them with an ellipsis.
fix.fix: Lead with the words that matter and keep titles near 60 characters.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
Model-training crawlers are blocked by choice
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The start page arrived in 341 ms
Every page has a meta description
